response.text:
I don’t have access to your ticket system, so I can’t give a real count. I can, however, offer sensible ballpark ranges and exactly how to get a quick estimate you can drop in the deck.

Ballpark ranges (typical):
- Stable SSO (no recent changes): ~1–5% of support tickets
- Recent SSO rollout/migration or frequent account provisioning: ~10–30%
- Major SSO outage or company-wide breakage during the quarter: ~30–60%

If you need a single conservative placeholder for a deck and don’t plan to label it precise, use “≈5% (estimate)” and mark it as an estimate.

Quick ways to get a quick estimate yourself
- By tag/label (best): count tickets tagged “sso”, “single-sign-on”, “saml”, etc. then divide by total tickets.
- By keyword search: search subjects/descriptions for keywords: sso, “single sign-on”, SAML, OAuth, “login via”, “SSO break”, “identity provider” — matched tickets ÷ total tickets.
- Sample and extrapolate: randomly sample N tickets (e.g., 200) and compute share with SSO keywords, then extrapolate to the full dataset.

Example simple formula:
SSO% = (number of SSO tickets ÷ total tickets) × 100

If you want, paste:
- total tickets last quarter and either SSO-tagged count or a small exported sample (CSV), and I’ll calculate the percent and give suggested wording for the slide.
